issues.explanation: Only the three table migrations are delivered; models, factories, pairing command, auth endpoint, JWT, middleware, the queues/priorities/ticket endpoints, routes/api.php, throttling and CORS are all missing, so none of the task's behaviour exists.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests are included, violating the mandatory TDD convention and leaving every requirement unverified.
Required token validation, entity/queue scope enforcement, rate limiting and the CORS origin allow-list are not implemented.
The task and conventions require updating these docs in the same change; none are touched, even database-schema.md for the new tables.

Timestamps 000001/000002/000003 look hand-numbered rather than generated by make:migration, though the content is equivalent.

review.summary: The change adds only the three migrations for totems, totem_presets and totem_preset_queue; these match the specified schema and are reversible. Everything else the task requires (models, factories, pairing command, JWT auth, middleware, the four API endpoints, throttling, CORS, config, docs and tests) is missing, so the PR cannot be approved.
